title: gtm-cs-1on1-prep-jamie-lee-ana-morales-2026-03-27
content:
Meeting prep: 1:1 with Ana Morales (AE)
Date/Time: 2026-03-27 10:00 AM PT
Location: Zoom / slack huddle after

Objectives:
- Align on ACME Health renewal strategy (renewal due 2026-05-15)
- Surface technical blockers for Dedicated migration pilot
- Prioritize PS/SE time for Q2 onboarding

Top account notes:
- ARR: ~$420k annualized; expansion opp in clinical analytics team (~$80k)
- Current usage: hosted API; latency complaints in EU region; exploring Dedicated for predictability
- Health signals: tokens/day down 12% MoM after model change (possible UI bug)
- Contract: SOW for Dedicated pilot drafted, legal review in progress (Confluence page linked)

Talking points / questions for Ana:
- Where are we on legal review? ETA from Acme legal? (last heard 3/20)
- Which internal stakeholders championing Dedicated? Who's the technical decision maker?
- Has SE completed latency reproduction in EU? Any diagnostics to share?
- Acceptable SLOs for Acme: p95 < 400ms for small payloads? Confirm
- Are they open to a short-term discount for pilot in exchange for case study?

Notes to self (quick bullets):
- Bring up auto-burst option (Dedicated) as an interim to handle EU traffic spikes
- Remind Ana to push for legal reviewer contact; get direct email
- Ask SE to prepare: perf numbers (p50/p95), KV cache config used, quantization profile attempted
- Prepare a one-pager with cost delta: hosted vs dedicated vs private (2 variants)

Open issues / blockers:
- Legal review delay (Acme legal requested SOC2 attestation copy)
- SE bandwidth: onboarding calendar full until 4/10
- Latency repro inconsistent; need request traces from Acme's prod traffic window (3/18-3/22)

Action items (owner / due):
- Ana: nudge Acme legal for reviewer contact + share SOC2 doc (due 2026-03-30)
- Jamie (me): create dedicated vs hosted cost one-pager and send before next sync (due 2026-04-01)
- Morgan (SE): run EU perf reproduction and share p50/p95 + config (due 2026-03-31)
- Product: confirm auto-burst policy parameters with eng (tagging product@redwood) (due 2026-04-05)
- Ana & Jamie: schedule pilot kickoff meeting (aim week of 4/13)

Follow-ups to bring to next 1:1:
- Legal reviewer name + timeline
- SE perf report and suggested mitigations
- Updated SOW with pilot acceptance criteria
- Decision on discount / pilot pricing model

Prep materials to attach / send ahead:
- Cost one-pager (Jamie)
- SOC2 PDF (from legal folder)
- Draft SOW (Confluence link)
- Slack thread snapshot: #acct-acme-health (latest concerns)

Notes to capture during call:
- Exact acceptance criteria for pilot (who signs off)
- Any change in timeline from their side (hiring freeze, budget windows)
- Blocking integrations: SSO / KMS availability for Private option

Tone and coaching reminders for Ana:
- Push for a firm commitment to a pilot timeline; ask "what would make this a yes?"
- Use pricing concession only if we get a customer story / case study commitment
- Keep ask specific: 2-week pilot, defined success metrics, 1 SE point of contact

Misc / misc notes:
- Past notes: 2026-02-12: initial discussion; 2026-03-10: tech demo with SE; 3/20 legal pinged
- Risk: if legal delays past 4/20, renewal at risk due to procurement cycle
- Good signals: Product team excited about Clinical Analytics use-case; potential cross-sell
